title: Indian Payroll Components (PF, ESI, Professional Tax)
summary: Statutory Indian payroll contributions on employee contracts, with a monthly computation sheet
intro: Provident Fund, ESI and professional tax worked out from the data already on the employee's contract, with the month's working kept as a record you can review. Every rate, ceiling, threshold and slab is an editable record carrying its own effective-from date, so a change of rate is a change of data rather than a change of code.
features: Employee and employer share, the statutory wage ceiling, and the split of the employer share between the pension scheme and the PF account. A per-contract switch contributes on actual wages above the ceiling where the employer has agreed to.

Employee and employer share on gross wages with the coverage threshold, including the rule most spreadsheets get wrong: an employee who crosses the threshold part way through a contribution period stays covered until that period ends.
A state levy, so it is modelled as a state-wise slab table - state, wage band, monthly tax, and the special-month amount used by states such as Maharashtra and Karnataka to reach the annual cap.
PF account number, UAN, ESI number, a switch per component and the state whose professional tax schedule applies. No Aadhaar number is stored anywhere.
Pick a month and a set of employees, press Compute, and every component is worked out per employee with a line, per-component totals and a grand total. Confirm the sheet to keep it as reviewed.
Rates, ceilings, thresholds and slabs are ordinary records with effective-from dates, so a revision is added alongside the old one and history is never rewritten.
notes: Depends on hr only. No Enterprise module and no third-party module is required.
It does not generate payslips, it posts no accounting entries and it makes no call to any government portal.

Starting figures were checked on 15 September 2026: PF 12% both sides on a wage ceiling of INR 15,000 with 8.33% to the pension scheme, ESI 0.75% and 3.25% on a threshold of INR 21,000. Sources are cited in the data file header.
Professional tax slabs ship for Maharashtra, Karnataka, West Bengal, Gujarat and Telangana only. Verify them against the current state notification and add the states you operate in.
These figures change and states revise their schedules. Review every number with your payroll adviser before relying on a computed sheet.
